title: Cover: Lifting without squeezing: a delicate yet strong soft gripper. Our 1 g soft gripper can hold over 1.6 kg, yet applies only a few mN of closing force, enabling handling of fragile and soft objects. The 1000x ratio of lifting force over closing force is a result of the combination of artificial muscles, to gently close the gripper's finger onto the object, and of electroadhesion-functionalized fingertips, to generate high shear forces. All these functions are enclosed into a monollitic stretchable silicone structure. By moving the fingers apart, one can grasp large objects, such as fruit and vegetables. EPFL, Soft Transducers Lab (LMTS); Vito Cacucciolo, Jun Shintake, Herbert Shea. The version of the gripper shown on the cover is still unpublished, but it is an evolution of the device published in the following work: Shintake J, Rosset S, Schubert B, et al. Versatile soft grippers with intrinsic electroadhesion based on multifunctional polymer actuators. Adv Mater 2016;28:231–238. Cacucciolo V, Shintake J, Shea H. Delicate yet strong: characterizing the electro-adhesion lifting force with a soft gripper. In: IEEE International Conference on Soft Robotics (RoboSoft), Seoul, Korea, 2019.
Correction to: Soft Pneumatic Actuator Fascicles for High Force and Reliability by Robertson MA, Sadeghi H, Florez JM, Paik J. Soft Robot 2017;4:23–32. DOI: 10.1089/soro.2016.0029
